from org.apache.commons.io import IOUtils
from java.nio.charset import StandardCharsets
import json

orig = session.get()
if orig is not None:
    # читаем и закрываем InputStream
    in_stream = session.read(orig)
    try:
        xml = IOUtils.toString(in_stream, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
    finally:
        in_stream.close()

    folder_id = "b1gn20an8tip613g6sv1"
    source_lang = "ru"
    target_lang = "en"
    max_len = 9000

    chunks = [ xml[i:i+max_len] for i in range(0, len(xml), max_len) ]
    total = len(chunks)

    for idx, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
        ff = session.create(orig)
        # выставляем индекс и общее число чанков
        ff = session.putAttribute(ff, "fragment.index", str(idx))
        ff = session.putAttribute(ff, "fragment.count", str(total))
        # собираем JSON-payload
        payload = {
            "folderId": folder_id,
            "sourceLanguageCode": source_lang,
            "targetLanguageCode": target_lang,
            "texts": [ chunk ]
        }
        data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        # записываем JSON в контент
        def write_cb(out):
            out.write(data)
        ff = session.write(ff, write_cb)
        session.transfer(ff, REL_SUCCESS)

    # удаляем оригинал (большой)
    session.remove(orig)

properties.Script Body:
from java.util.zip import ZipInputStream
from java.io import BufferedInputStream

flowFile = session.get()
if flowFile is not None:
    is_stream = session.read(flowFile)
    zis = ZipInputStream(BufferedInputStream(is_stream))
    found = False
    try:
        entry = zis.getNextEntry()
        while entry is not None:
            if entry.getName().startswith("word/media/"):
                found = True
                break
            entry = zis.getNextEntry()
    finally:
        zis.close()
        is_stream.close()

    # ставим атрибут, но всегда в success
    flowFile = session.putAttribute(flowFile, "hasImages", str(found).lower())
    session.transfer(flowFile, REL_SUCCESS)
